elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: IBM provides assistance only “at Customer's request,” adding a separate trigger not present in the preferred position.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
Vendor returns or makes available all Customer Data upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Return or download of all Content is conditioned on a Customer request rather than arising automatically upon expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires all Content to be provided “in a commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable-format requirement.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day period runs from “Customer's request,” not from expiry or termination. A later request could therefore result in delivery more than 30 days after the triggering event.

elements.element: Vendor deletes Customer Data after its return or export.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires IBM to “thereafter delete all Content from its systems,” referring to the return/download obligation in subsection (b).

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion after deleting Customer Data.
elements.evidence: IBM must “certify such deletion to Customer in writing.”

elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly applies upon expiration or termination.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The assistance obligation is conditioned on a separate Customer request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The stated period of up to six months encompasses the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor exports or makes available Customer Data upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: IBM's obligation to return or make Content available for download arises only upon Customer's request.

elements.element: Customer Data is exported within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause measures 30 days from Customer's request rather than from expiry or termination.

result.reason: Neither level is fully satisfied because the assistance and data-export duties are request-dependent, and the 30-day export deadline runs from Customer's request rather than expiry or termination. The clause also applies upon termination of any single Service Option Attachment but then requires deletion of “all Content,” which could disrupt continuing attachments and conflict with the original clause's preservation of obligations under those attachments.
